job.job_description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy enterprise-grade Generative AI applications leveraging cloud-native architectures and modern LLM ecosystems. The ideal candidate will have strong data engineering foundations combined with expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and AI service integration.


Responsibilities

Design and develop GenAI applications using Python and enterprise LLM platforms.
Build scalable data pipelines for structured and unstructured data processing.
Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and vector-based search solutions.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise applications through APIs and workflows.
Develop cloud-native AI services on AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks (DBRX), or Snowflake.
Create agent-based solutions using LangChain and LangGraph.
Ensure data quality, governance, and security compliance across AI workflows.
Optimize performance, scalability, and reliability of AI solutions.


Technical Requirements

Core Skills

Python
SQL
ETL/ELT
Data Modeling
Data Quality
Cloud-native Development
API Integration
Data Engineering
ETL
Document Processing
Workflow design
knowledge of LLM development
RAG
Prompt Engineering
AI Coding Assistants


Advanced Skills

RAG Data Pipelines
LLM Data Integration
AI Service Integration
Scalable AI Deployments
Agent Orchestration
Tool Calling
LangGraph
LangChain


Additional Responsibility

Experience with Hugging Face, LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source LLMs.
Familiarity with knowledge graphs and semantic search.
Experience building production-grade GenAI solutions.


Educational Requirement

Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor Of Technology (Integrated)


Preferred Skills

Technology->AI-Data science->Machine Learning
Technology->AI-Generative AI->Artificial Intelligence - BASIC
Technology->AI-Generative AI->Generative AI for Data Analytics


Service Line

Data Analytics Unit
